name: softicon-virtual-tour
description: 360° panorama and virtual tour block for WordPress: scenes and hotspots built in the block editor

scripts.zip:
rm -f softicon-virtual-tour.zip && printf '→ Building block
' && (npm run -s build >/dev/null 2>&1 || npm run build) && printf '→ Translations
' && (npm run -s i18n-pot >/dev/null 2>&1 || npm run i18n-pot) && npm run -s find-ds && printf '→ Zipping
' && cd .. && zip -rq softicon-virtual-tour/softicon-virtual-tour.zip softicon-virtual-tour/softicon-virtual-tour.php softicon-virtual-tour/index.php softicon-virtual-tour/includes softicon-virtual-tour/src softicon-virtual-tour/build softicon-virtual-tour/languages softicon-virtual-tour/readme.txt softicon-virtual-tour/package.json softicon-virtual-tour/webpack.config.js -x '*/.DS_Store' '*.map' 'softicon-virtual-tour/src/render.php'
scripts.postzip:
printf '
✔ Zip ready: %s
  %s files, %s

' "$PWD/softicon-virtual-tour.zip" "$(unzip -l softicon-virtual-tour.zip | tail -1 | awk '{print $2}')" "$(du -h softicon-virtual-tour.zip | cut -f1 | tr -d ' ')"
scripts.bundle: npm run lint && npm run zip
